title: Steve Jobs in 2010, at D8 Conference (Full Video)
summary: The full 2010 D8 conference interview of Steve Jobs by Walt Mossberg and Kara Swisher. He discusses Flash, privacy, multitouch, payments and what motivates him.
why: Commenters cite timestamps from it as a primary source for Jobs' views on specific topics.

quote.text: Privacy means people know what they are signing up for in plain English and repeatedly.
